verdict.rationale: Pipedrive markets AI features, so a buyer could reasonably ask whether its AI can consume external MCP servers, and the axis applies. The only MCP evidence is Pipedrive's own MCP server, which lets external AI assistants act on Pipedrive data. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing shows Pipedrive connecting to or using tools from third-party MCP servers.
